title: Rainbows
info: White sunlight is a mix of colors. Raindrops can spread those colors apart.
A rainbow shows red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.
You see a rainbow when the Sun is behind you and rain is in front of you.

questions.q: The top color of a common rainbow is
options: Violet only, with red at the top never

questions.q: To see a rainbow, the Sun is usually
options: In front of you, shining in your eyes at the rain
